# Octree

> Octree is an AI-assisted LaTeX editor with document editing, PDF compilation and AI chat.

## Product and documentation

- [Website](https://www.useoctree.com): Product information and current plans.
- [Editor](https://app.useoctree.com): Sign in to write and compile a document.
- [Learning hub](https://www.useoctree.com/learn): Code-based LaTeX tutorials.
- [Blog](https://www.useoctree.com/blog): Articles and comparisons.
- [Developer documentation](https://www.useoctree.com/developers): LaTeX compilation API and MCP server.
- [Full reference](https://www.useoctree.com/llms-full.txt): API reference and learning inventory.
- [Contact](https://www.useoctree.com/contact): Contact Octree.

Plan limits and prices can change; use the website and the signed-in billing screen rather than treating this discovery file as a price list.

## Learning guides

- [Learn LaTeX: Tutorial for Beginners](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/latex): Your first LaTeX document in minutes, a step-by-step learning path, what to install (or not), the preamble, math, tables, figures, citations and reading the error log.
- [LaTeX Errors and Warnings](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors): What 40 common LaTeX error messages mean and how to fix them: Undefined control sequence, Missing $ inserted, Missing \right. inserted, Runaway argument, Overfull \hbox and more.
- [Learn TikZ](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/tikz): Create stunning diagrams, graphs, and illustrations directly in your LaTeX documents with the powerful TikZ package.
- [pgfplots in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/pgfplots): Plot data and functions in LaTeX with pgfplots: line plots from coordinates and CSV files, function graphs, bar charts, legends and common errors.
- [Bold, Italics & Underline](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/bold-italics-underline): Bold, italic and underlined text in LaTeX with \textbf, \textit, \emph and \underline, plus small caps, monospace, font sizes and the soul and ulem packages.
- [Page Size & Margins](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/page-size-margins): Control page layout in LaTeX with the geometry package. Set paper size, margins, headers, and landscape mode.
- [Subscripts & Superscripts](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/subscripts-superscripts): Write subscripts and superscripts in LaTeX for math, chemistry, and scientific notation with practical examples.
- [Lists and Bullet Points](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/lists): Bullet points and numbered lists in LaTeX with itemize, enumerate and description. Custom bullets, enumitem labels and spacing, inline lists and Beamer.
- [LaTeX Document Classes: article, report, book and Options](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/document-classes): LaTeX document classes compared: article, report, book, KOMA-Script and memoir, and the options 12pt, a4paper, twoside, twocolumn, draft and landscape.
- [Title Page in LaTeX: \maketitle, titlepage and Custom Designs](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/title-page): Make a title page in LaTeX: \title, \author, \date and \maketitle, the titlepage environment for custom designs with a logo, a thesis example and fixes.
- [Fonts in LaTeX: Families, Sans Serif, and Changing the Font](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/fonts): Fonts in LaTeX: serif, sans serif and monospace families, \textsf and \sffamily, font packages like newtx and libertine, fontspec with XeLaTeX, and fixes.
- [Indentation in LaTeX: \indent, \noindent, parindent and Tabs](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/paragraphs-indentation): Indent in LaTeX: the default first-line indent, \noindent, \parindent and parskip, \indent, hanging indents, indented blocks and tabs with \hspace.
- [Environments in LaTeX: \begin, \end and Defining Your Own](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/environments): LaTeX environments explained: \begin and \end, common environments, \newenvironment, a numbered example environment with amsthm, arguments and fixes.
- [LaTeX Commands and Macros: \newcommand, \renewcommand and \def](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/commands-macros): LaTeX commands and macros: define your own with \newcommand, arguments and defaults, \renewcommand, \DeclareMathOperator, \def, and 40 common LaTeX codes.
- [LaTeX Symbols: The Complete List](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/latex-symbols): Every common LaTeX symbol with its command and package: math operators, Greek letters, relations, logic and set symbols, arrows, brackets, special characters and big operators.
- [Greek Letters in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/greek-letters-math-symbols): All 24 Greek letters in LaTeX with uppercase, variants and Unicode, \epsilon vs \varepsilon, lambda, bold and upright Greek, plus every common math symbol.
- [Using Colors in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/colors): Add colors to your LaTeX documents with the xcolor package. Text color, backgrounds, custom colors, and color mixing.
- [Framebox and Boxed Text](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/framebox): Draw a box around text with \fbox and \framebox: fixed widths and alignment, empty boxes and checkboxes for forms, multi-line boxes with \parbox and minipage, \boxed equations and colored frames.
- [Inline and Display Math in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/mathematical-expressions): Inline math with $...$ and \(...\), display math with \[...\] and equation, why $$ is discouraged, \text in math, fractions, roots and common math errors.
- [Piecewise Functions in LaTeX: the cases Environment](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/piecewise-functions): Write piecewise functions in LaTeX with \begin{cases} (amsmath): \text{if} conditions, dcases for full-size fractions, right braces, numbering and fixes.
- [Integrals, Sums & Limits](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/integrals-sums-limits): Typeset integrals, sums (\sum), products and limits in LaTeX. From basic sigma notation to series, big operators and partial derivatives.
- [Matrices in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/matrices): Matrices in LaTeX with amsmath: pmatrix and bmatrix, 2x2, 3x3 and 4x4 examples, determinants, inverse and transpose, augmented and block matrices.
- [LaTeX Tables](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/tables): Make tables in LaTeX and Overleaf with booktabs, multicolumn, multirow, longtable, row and column spacing, colored tables and a table generator.
- [Figures in LaTeX: \includegraphics, Captions and References](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/images): Figures in LaTeX: \includegraphics with width and scale, the figure environment, [htbp] and [H] placement, captions, \label and \ref, wrapfig and errors.
- [Subfigures in LaTeX: Side-by-Side Figures with subcaption](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/subfigures): LaTeX subfigures with the subcaption package: two figures side by side, a 2×2 grid, panel captions and labels, \ref and \subref, legacy subfig and fixes.
- [Two Columns in LaTeX: twocolumn, multicol and \multicolumn in Tables](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/multiple-columns): Two columns in LaTeX: the twocolumn option, the multicol package with \columnbreak and \columnsep, figure* across columns, and \multicolumn in tables.
- [LaTeX Footnotes](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/footnotes): Add footnotes in LaTeX with \footnote, put footnotes in tables and captions, use symbols instead of numbers, and style them with footmisc.
- [The Greek Alphabet](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/greek-alphabet): All 24 Greek letters in order with uppercase, lowercase, pronunciation, Unicode, math and science uses, and LaTeX commands.
- [APA Title Page Format](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/apa-title-page): APA 7 student and professional title pages: exact elements, formatting rules, worked examples, and the apa7 LaTeX class.
- [LaTeX Hyperlinks](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/hyperlinks): Clickable links in LaTeX with hyperref: \url, \href, email links, internal references, link colors, removing link boxes, and PDF metadata.
- [LaTeX Comments](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/comments): Single-line comments with %, block comments with the comment package and \iffalse, editor shortcuts, todonotes, and draft/final switches.
- [LaTeX Page Numbering](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/page-numbering): Roman and arabic page numbers, starting at a given page, removing the number on the title page, fancyhdr footers, "Page X of Y" and Beamer frame numbers.
- [Horizontal Line in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/horizontal-lines): \hrule, \rule and \hrulefill, partial and centred lines, colored and dashed rules, table rules with booktabs, header rules and signature lines.
- [Quotes in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/quotes): The ``double'' and `single' convention, csquotes \enquote and \textquote, German and French quotes, quote and quotation environments, block quotes with attribution and Beamer.
- [Strikethrough & Cross Out](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/strikethrough): Strike through text with ulem \sout and soul \st, cancel terms in math with the cancel package, cross out in tables and Beamer, and track changes.
- [Font Size in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/font-size): Change font size in LaTeX: the ten size commands from \tiny to \Huge with exact point sizes, class options, extsizes, \fontsize, and sizes for captions, footnotes and headings.
- [Equation Numbering & Referencing](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/equation-numbering): Number, label and reference equations with \label, \eqref and cleveref, number per section, add custom tags, and break long equations with align, split and multline.
- [Special Characters in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/special-characters): Print the reserved characters # $ % & _ { } ~ ^ \, the pipe, < and >, underscores in URLs and file names, inverted ?/!, degree, copyright and currency signs, and fix the errors they cause.
- [Brackets & Parentheses](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/brackets): Every delimiter from ( ) to \langle \rangle, curly braces (accolades) in text, automatic sizing with \left \right, manual \big to \Bigg, matrix brackets, cases and \underbrace.
- [Underbrace and Overbrace in LaTeX: \underbrace, \overbrace and Annotations](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/underbrace-overbrace): Underbrace in LaTeX: \underbrace{a+b}_{\text{sum}}, \overbrace with labels, nested and overlapping braces, \underset, \overset, \underbracket and errors.
- [Multiline Equations in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/multiline-equations): New lines in equations, align math with align and align*, split, multline, gather and cases, nest aligned blocks, add text between lines, allow page breaks, and retire eqnarray.
- [Sections & Headings](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/sections): The heading hierarchy per class, unnumbered sections that still appear in the TOC, secnumdepth and tocdepth, custom numbering, titlesec formatting, \appendix and hyperref links.
- [Appendix in LaTeX: \appendix, Numbering and the appendix Package](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/appendix): Appendix in LaTeX: \appendix for lettered sections and chapters, the appendix package, appendices in the table of contents, equation numbering and errors.
- [Code Listings in LaTeX: listings, minted and verbatim](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/code-listings): Code in LaTeX: lstlisting with language=Python, \lstinputlisting, \lstset styling, minted and -shell-escape, verbatim, \verb and \lstinline, plus errors.
- [Algorithms in LaTeX: algorithm2e, algorithmic and algpseudocode](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/algorithms): Write pseudocode in LaTeX: algorithm with algpseudocode (\State, \If, \For), algorithm2e, the old algorithmic, line numbers, captions and errors.
- [Theorems, Lemmas & Proofs](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/theorems-proofs): Set up amsthm and \newtheorem, share theorem and lemma counters, write proofs, and set the end of proof symbol (∎) with \qedsymbol and \qedhere.
- [Glossaries, Acronyms & Abbreviations](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/glossaries-acronyms): The glossaries package (\newacronym, \gls, \printglossaries, makeglossaries and latexmk), the simpler acronym package, nomencl for symbol lists, sorting and common errors.
- [Math Functions: log, exp, argmax, abs, norm](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/math-functions): \log, \ln, \exp and every predefined operator, argmax with \DeclareMathOperator*, floor and ceiling, absolute value and norms with mathtools, roots, fractions and function notation.
- [Molecular Orbital Diagrams](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/molecular-orbital-diagrams): Read and fill MO diagrams for H2, O2, N2 and CO with bond orders, then draw them with the modiagram package, pure TikZ, chemfig Lewis structures and mhchem formulas.
- [Laplace Transform Table](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/laplace-transform-table): 26 Laplace transform pairs with regions of convergence, every property and theorem, worked inverse transforms by partial fractions, and the LaTeX source for the table.
- [Derivative Rules](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/derivative-rules): Power, product, quotient and chain rules, a table of common and trig derivatives, the six inverse trig derivatives, worked examples and the LaTeX for every formula.
- [APA Headings](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/apa-headings): The five APA 7 heading levels with exact formatting, the rules for choosing a level, a worked outline of a student paper, and the headings in LaTeX with apa7 or titlesec.
- [AMA Citation Format](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/ama-citation-format): Superscript in-text citations, the numbered reference list, examples for journal articles, books, chapters, websites and reports, AMA vs APA vs Vancouver, and AMA citations in LaTeX.
- [MLA In-Text Citation](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/mla-in-text-citation): The author-page rule, one to three-plus authors, corporate and missing authors, no page numbers, qtd. in, block quotes, repeat citations, a ten-example table and MLA citations in LaTeX with biblatex-mla.
- [MLA Book Citation](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/mla-book-citation): The Works Cited pattern for a book, examples for one or more authors, edited, translated, later-edition, e-book, multivolume and no-author books with their in-text forms, and a generated Works Cited in LaTeX.
- [Bibliography Examples](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/bibliography-examples): APA 7, MLA 9, Chicago and IEEE bibliography entries with the BibTeX source for each, complete thebibliography, BibTeX and biblatex documents, an annotated bibliography example and the common errors.
- [Blackboard Bold in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/blackboard-bold): \mathbb{R} with amssymb, all 26 letters with their Unicode code points, lowercase letters and the indicator 1 with dsfont, bbm and bbold, \symbb with unicode-math, bold vs blackboard bold, and the common mistakes.
- [Approximately Equal Symbol (≈)](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/approximately-equal): What ≈ means, ≈ vs ~ vs ≃ vs ≅ with Unicode code points, how to type it on Windows, Mac, iPhone, Android and in HTML, and \approx, \not\approx, \sim and the amssymb variants in LaTeX.
- [Table of Contents in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/table-of-contents): A complete table of contents example, \tableofcontents and the .toc file, tocdepth vs secnumdepth, unnumbered entries, hyperref links, renaming, tocloft styling, lists of figures and Beamer outlines.
- [Footnotes in Beamer](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/beamer-footnote): Footnotes on Beamer slides: \footnote[frame] in columns, footnotes without a number, smaller size and color, per-frame numbering, overlays, title-page \thanks and \footcite.
- [Beamer Presentations](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/beamer): Slides in LaTeX with Beamer: frames, themes and color themes, overlays with \pause and \only, columns and blocks, title page and sections, handouts and speaker notes.
- [Spacing in LaTeX](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/spacing): Horizontal and vertical spacing: \hspace, \vspace, \quad, the math spaces \, \: \; \! with their widths, line spacing with setspace and paragraph spacing.
- [XeLaTeX: Unicode, System Fonts and When to Use It](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/xelatex): XeLaTeX vs pdfLaTeX vs LuaLaTeX, system fonts with fontspec and \setmainfont, Unicode input, polyglossia for RTL languages, xeCJK and common errors.
- [Languages in LaTeX: babel, polyglossia, Spanish, Arabic and More](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/languages): LaTeX in any language: babel for pdfLaTeX, polyglossia for XeLaTeX, Spanish, French, German, Arabic and Hebrew, Chinese and Japanese, Russian, Greek.

## LaTeX errors and warnings

- [LaTeX error: Undefined control sequence](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/undefined-control-sequence): What "! Undefined control sequence" means in LaTeX: a misspelled command or a missing package. How to find the command in the log and fix it.
- [LaTeX error: Missing $ inserted](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/missing-dollar-inserted): Why LaTeX says "Missing $ inserted": a math symbol like _, ^ or \alpha outside math mode, or a blank line inside an equation. How to fix it.
- [LaTeX error: Missing \right. inserted](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/missing-right-inserted): Fix "Missing \right. inserted" and "Extra \right" in LaTeX: every \left needs a \right in the same group, even across lines of align.
- [LaTeX error: Missing } inserted](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/missing-brace-inserted): What "Missing } inserted" means in LaTeX: a group that never closed before math ended, a table cell or \item started. Common causes and fixes.
- [LaTeX error: Extra }, or forgotten $](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/extra-brace-or-forgotten-dollar): Fix "Extra }, or forgotten $" in LaTeX: a closing brace without an opening one, or a brace closed inside math that was opened outside it.
- [LaTeX error: Too many }'s](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/too-many-braces): What "Too many }'s" means in LaTeX: a closing brace with no open group, usually left after deleting a command. How to find and remove it.
- [LaTeX error: Runaway argument?](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/runaway-argument): Fix "Runaway argument?" and "Paragraph ended before ... was complete" in LaTeX: an argument whose closing brace is missing. How to find it.
- [LaTeX error: Paragraph ended before … was complete](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/paragraph-ended-before-complete): Fix "Paragraph ended before \x was complete" in LaTeX: a blank line inside an argument such as \author, \label or \cite, or a missing brace.
- [LaTeX error: Command already defined](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/command-already-defined): Fix "LaTeX Error: Command \x already defined" in LaTeX: \newcommand clashes with an existing macro. Rename it or use \renewcommand.
- [LaTeX error: Illegal parameter number in definition](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/illegal-parameter-number): Fix "Illegal parameter number in definition" in LaTeX: #2 used in a macro that takes fewer arguments, or a # inside a nested definition.
- [LaTeX error: Environment align undefined](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/environment-undefined): What "LaTeX Error: Environment ... undefined" means, why align, figure* or tikzpicture trigger it, and the one-line \usepackage fix.
- [LaTeX error: \begin{itemize} ended by \end{enumerate}](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/begin-ended-by-end): Fix "LaTeX Error: \begin{x} on input line n ended by \end{y}": find the environment that was never closed or the \end with the wrong name.
- [LaTeX error: Missing \begin{document}](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/missing-begin-document): Why LaTeX says "Missing \begin{document}" when the line is there: text or a stray character in the preamble, a BOM, or a broken .sty or .bib file.
- [LaTeX error: Something's wrong--perhaps a missing \item](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/missing-item): Fix "Something's wrong--perhaps a missing \item": text in a list before the first \item, an empty thebibliography, or \\ at the start of a line.
- [LaTeX error: Lonely \item (missing list environment)](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/lonely-item): What "Lonely \item--perhaps a missing list environment" means and how to fix it: wrap the \item lines in itemize, enumerate or description.
- [LaTeX error: Misplaced alignment tab character &](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/misplaced-alignment-tab): Fix "Misplaced alignment tab character &": escape a literal ampersand as \&, or put the & inside a table, align or matrix where it belongs.
- [LaTeX error: Extra alignment tab has been changed to \cr](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/extra-alignment-tab): Fix "Extra alignment tab has been changed to \cr": a table row has more & cells than the column spec, or a row is missing its \\.
- [LaTeX error: There's no line here to end](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/no-line-here-to-end): Fix "There's no line here to end": \\ used after a blank line, at the start of a paragraph or after a list. Use \vspace or a blank line instead.
- [LaTeX error: Not in outer par mode](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/not-in-outer-par-mode): Fix "Not in outer par mode": a figure, table or \marginpar placed inside a minipage, \parbox, box, table cell or another float. Use \captionof instead.
- [LaTeX error: You can't use \hrule here except with leaders](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/hrule-here-except-with-leaders): Fix "You can't use `\hrule' here except with leaders": \hrule in a table cell, box or math. Use \hline in tables and \rule elsewhere.
- [LaTeX error: Double subscript](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/double-subscript): Fix the LaTeX "Double subscript" and "Double superscript" errors: group the indices with braces, as in x_{ij}, x_{i_j} or x^{2^3}.
- [LaTeX error: Bad math environment delimiter](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/bad-math-environment-delimiter): Why LaTeX reports "Bad math environment delimiter": an opening \[ or \( where a closing \] or \) belongs, or nested math. How to fix it.
- [LaTeX error: \begin{split} won't work here](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/split-wont-work-here): Fix amsmath's \begin{split} won't work here: split must sit inside equation, gather or another math display, never on its own or inside align.
- [LaTeX error: Illegal unit of measure (pt inserted)](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/illegal-unit-of-measure): Fix "Illegal unit of measure (pt inserted)" in LaTeX: a length such as \vspace{2} needs a unit like 2cm, 2em or 12pt. Common causes and fixes.
- [LaTeX error: Missing number, treated as zero](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/missing-number-treated-as-zero): Fix "Missing number, treated as zero" in LaTeX: a number or length was expected, often after \\ followed by [ or an empty length argument.
- [LaTeX error: Dimension too large](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/dimension-too-large): Fix "Dimension too large" in LaTeX: TeX lengths stop at about 5.75 m (16383.99pt). Common in pgfplots and TikZ with big data; rescale or use fpu.
- [LaTeX error: TeX capacity exceeded, sorry](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/tex-capacity-exceeded): Why LaTeX says "TeX capacity exceeded, sorry [input stack size]": almost always an infinite loop, such as a command redefined in terms of itself.
- [LaTeX error: Emergency stop](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/emergency-stop): What "Emergency stop" means in LaTeX: the run was aborted, usually by a missing \end{document}, a missing file or an earlier error. How to find the cause.
- [LaTeX error: I can't find file](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/i-cant-find-file): Fix "I can't find file" in LaTeX: the file passed to \input or the compiler does not exist at that path. Check the name, folder and braces.
- [LaTeX error: File `x.sty' not found (missing package)](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/file-not-found): Fix "LaTeX Error: File `x.sty' not found": the package name is misspelled or not installed. How to check the name and install missing packages.
- [LaTeX error: Option clash for package](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/option-clash): Fix "Option clash for package" in LaTeX: a package was loaded twice with different options, often by another package. Pass the options once, first.
- [LaTeX error: Package babel Error: Unknown option](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/babel-unknown-option): Fix "Package babel Error: Unknown option" in LaTeX: a misspelled language name or a language file that is not installed. Check the name, then install it.
- [LaTeX error: Unicode character not set up for use](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/inputenc-unicode-character): Fix "Unicode character not set up for use with LaTeX" (inputenc error): pdfLaTeX has no glyph for a pasted symbol. Use the LaTeX command or XeLaTeX.
- [LaTeX warning: Font shape `OT1/cmr/bx/sc' undefined](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/font-shape-undefined): Fix "Font shape undefined" in LaTeX: the font has no such weight or shape (bold small caps, bold monospace), so LaTeX substitutes. Pick a font that has it.
- [LaTeX warning: Token not allowed in a PDF string](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/hyperref-token-not-allowed): Fix the hyperref warning "Token not allowed in a PDF string": math or a command in a section title cannot go into PDF bookmarks. Use \texorpdfstring.
- [LaTeX error: Image file not found (pdftex.def)](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/image-file-not-found): Fix "Package pdftex.def Error: File not found: using draft setting": the image path in \includegraphics does not match a file the compiler can see.
- [LaTeX warning: Citation undefined](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/citation-undefined): Fix "LaTeX Warning: Citation undefined" and [?] in the PDF: the key is misspelled, missing from the .bib file, or BibTeX/Biber has not run yet.
- [LaTeX warning: Reference undefined](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/reference-undefined): Fix "LaTeX Warning: Reference undefined" and ?? in the PDF: a \ref with no matching \label, a typo, or a missing second compile. Plus duplicate labels.
- [LaTeX warning: Overfull \hbox (too wide) in paragraph](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/overfull-hbox): Fix "Overfull \hbox (too wide) in paragraph" and "Underfull \hbox (badness 10000)": a line that sticks into the margin, or one stretched too far.
- [LaTeX error: Too many unprocessed floats](https://www.useoctree.com/learn/errors/too-many-unprocessed-floats): Fix "Too many unprocessed floats" in LaTeX: figures and tables pile up because one cannot be placed. Relax the placement options or add \clearpage.

## Tools

- [Octree tools](https://tools.useoctree.com): LaTeX converters, preview, templates and reference tools.
- [Current tool inventory](https://tools.useoctree.com/llms.txt): Canonical tool links and descriptions.
- [LaTeX preview](https://tools.useoctree.com/tools/latex-preview): Compile LaTeX to a PDF preview.
- [Markdown to LaTeX](https://tools.useoctree.com/tools/markdown-to-latex): Convert Markdown into LaTeX.
- [Citation generator](https://tools.useoctree.com/tools/citation-generator): Generate citation entries.
